parameter.name: corner_basis
parameter.input_constraints: unchanged tiny-L grammar; demonstrations use incomplete orientation sets or distinct colors so opposite-corner settings differ

elbow.text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (mode g))
                  (k (quotient (- h 1) 2))
                  (objs (objects g bg))
                  (placements (map (lambda (obj)
                                     (let* ((color (obj-color obj))
                                            (r1 (obj-r1 obj))
                                            (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
                                            (r2 (obj-r2 obj))
                                            (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
                                            (tl (= (at g r1 c1) color))
                                            (tr (= (at g r1 c2) color))
                                            (bl (= (at g r2 c1) color))
                                            (br (= (at g r2 c2) color))
                                            (corner (cond
                                                      ((and tl tr bl) 'tl)
                                                      ((and tl tr br) 'tr)
                                                      ((and tl bl br) 'bl)
                                                      (else 'br))))
                                       (list corner color)))
                                   objs))
                  (covers? (lambda (p r c)
                             (let ((corner (first p)))
                               (cond
                                 ((eq? corner 'tl) (and (< r k) (< c k) (or (zero? r) (zero? c))))
                                 ((eq? corner 'tr) (and
                                     (< r k)
                                     (>= c (- w k))
                                     (or (zero? r) (= c (- w 1)))))
                                 ((eq? corner 'bl) (and
                                     (>= r (- h k))
                                     (< c k)
                                     (or (= r (- h 1)) (zero? c))))
                                 (else (and
                                         (>= r (- h k))
                                         (>= c (- w k))
                                         (or (= r (- h 1)) (= c (- w 1))))))))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let ((hit (find-first (lambda (p) (covers? p r c)) placements)))
                        (if hit (second hit) bg)))))))

limitations: Prototype only: it is not wired into production generation, canonical authority, catalog approval, or training admission.
Evidence covers two deterministic complete episodes and the single declared parameter rival, not every seed or every conceivable rival rule.
The generator deliberately uses incomplete orientation sets or distinct colors; a four-orientation same-color scene would make the two settings answer-equivalent.
